-- SQL DDL for CockroachDB, generated by ormbridge.

CREATE TYPE "Status" AS ENUM ('draft', 'live');

CREATE TABLE tenants (
  id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  status "Status" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  CONSTRAINT tenants_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT tenants_name_key UNIQUE (name)
);

CREATE TABLE accounts (
  id INT4 GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  age INT4,
  visits BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  balance NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL,
  bio TEXT,
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ON UPDATE now(),
  prefs JSONB,
  labels TEXT[] NOT NULL,
  grid JSONB, -- an array stored as JSON
  attributes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, -- hstore stored as JSONB
  stock_range TEXT, -- range stored as text
  last_ip INET,
  shelf_life INTERVAL,
  avatar BYTEA,
  status "Status" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  tenant_id UUID NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT accounts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT accounts_email_key UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT accounts_tenant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX accounts_created_at_idx ON accounts (created_at);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX accounts_email_status_key ON accounts (email, status);
CREATE INDEX accounts_prefs_idx ON accounts USING gin (prefs);
CREATE INDEX accounts_labels_idx ON accounts USING gin (labels);
CREATE INDEX accounts_email_idx ON accounts (email);
CREATE INDEX accounts_stock_range_idx ON accounts (stock_range);
CREATE INDEX accounts_age_idx ON accounts (age);
CREATE INDEX accounts_visits_idx ON accounts (visits);

CREATE TABLE events (
  id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  kind INT4 NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  account_id INT4,
  CONSTRAINT events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT events_account_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

--- warnings
Provider "cockroachdb": PostgreSQL-compatible DDL was written for CockroachDB: integers are sized explicitly (INT4, INT2, INT8) because a bare INT is 64-bit there, and PostgreSQL-only types and index methods are replaced and reported below.
Account.grid: CockroachDB has no multi-dimensional arrays; the column was written as JSONB.
Account.attributes: CockroachDB has no hstore type; the column was written as JSONB.
Account.stock_range: CockroachDB has no range types (int4range, tstzrange, ...); the column was written as text.
Account index (prefs): CockroachDB supports only trigram operator classes on inverted indexes; the operator class of "prefs" was dropped.
Account index (email): CockroachDB has no hash indexes (only B-tree and inverted GIN); an ordinary index was written (CREATE INDEX ... USING HASH is a hash-sharded B-tree there, a different feature).
Account index (stock_range): CockroachDB has no gist indexes (only B-tree and inverted GIN); an ordinary index was written.
Account index (age): CockroachDB has no brin indexes (only B-tree and inverted GIN); an ordinary index was written.
Account index (visits): CockroachDB builds an inverted (GIN) index only over JSONB, array, tsvector or spatial columns; "visits" is BIGINT, so an ordinary index was written.
Provider "cockroachdb": Account.id, Event.id are auto-increment keys: written as GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, which CockroachDB backs with a sequence (SERIAL would be unique_rowid(): 64-bit and not consecutive); sequential keys send every insert to the same range (a hot spot); CockroachDB recommends UUID keys with gen_random_uuid().
